# LinkedIn Manager
> CodesbyFebin agent skills for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube, and WhatsApp. Draft, audit, approve. No autopilot.

Repo: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/linkedin-manager
Index: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/linkedin-manager/blob/main/SKILLS.md
License: MIT
Maintainer: Febin Francis (CodesbyFebin)

## Use
Install in Claude Code with /plugin marketplace add CodesbyFebin/linkedin-manager
Skills draft. They publish only after the operator types yes.
Job skills do not scrape boards and do not submit applications.
